description: Defines view classes (IfView and LoopView) for inspecting and manipulating control flow nodes (if and loop) in Torch JIT IR graph.

classes.name: IfView
classes.description: A view class for inspecting and manipulating 'if' nodes in Torch JIT IR.

classes.name: LoopView
classes.description: A view class for inspecting and manipulating 'loop' nodes in Torch JIT IR.

methods.name: permuteOutputs
methods.description: Reorders the outputs of the node and its associated blocks.

methods.name: permuteLoopCarried
methods.description: Reorders loop-carried variables in the loop node.

methods.name: replaceMaxTripCount
methods.description: Replaces the maximum trip count input of the loop node.

methods.name: replaceInputCondition
methods.description: Replaces the condition input of the loop node.

methods.name: loopType
methods.description: Determines the type of loop (While, For, ModifiedLoop) based on node properties.
